about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Rashida Tlaib

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BANNING PRIVATE NDAs BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND CORPORATIONS
statements.title: BANNING PRIVATE NDAs BETWEEN GOVERNMENT AND CORPORATIONS
sentences: Elected officials and corporate CEOs have been making agreements behind closed doors about AI data centers, water utility privatization, and these big tax break packages, all hidden behind these NDAs.

Right now, in the city of Detroit, they are not debating $1 million or $100 million but a $548 million tax giveaway package for billionaire Dan Gilbert's Renaissance Center redevelopment, and we can't be informed.
Mr. Speaker, yesterday, I introduced the No Secret Deals Act to ban private nondisclosure agreements between government agencies and corporations.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALLING FOR REAL PROTECTIONS FROM DATA CENTERS
statements.title: CALLING FOR REAL PROTECTIONS FROM DATA CENTERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the so-called Ratepayer Protection Act won't do a darn thing to protect us from AI data centers.
It will only serve utility CEOs and encourage more data centers.
People across the country, no matter the political party, have been coming together, loud and clear, in saying that data centers are not welcome in our communities.
AI data centers are polluting our air and water and raising energy costs by as much as 267 percent.
We just saw a report that PFAS forever chemical manufacturers are increasing production to meet the demand for use in data centers.

Mr. Speaker, Congress needs to pass a national moratorium on data centers and pass my No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act before Trump turns Yellowstone over to OpenAI and Oracle. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM ACT OF 2026
statements.title: PROTECT ECONOMIC AND ACADEMIC FREEDOM ACT OF 2026
sentences: Support the Israeli Government and their war crimes or lose Federal student aid.
This is about protecting an image like this from Israel's National Security Minister this week.
They are doing what is right in our history, and I am not going to wait a decade for people to apologize for it, because they are trying to save lives.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP DATA SHARING BETWEEN ICE AND TSA
statements.title: STOP DATA SHARING BETWEEN ICE AND TSA
sentences: They are subjecting them to unconstitutional mass surveillance and creating a climate of fear for our immigrant neighbors.
We can't allow TSA to become complicit in ICE's cruelty, and I am asking the TSA administrator to stop openly lying about the secret data-sharing agreement that was entered into with ICE.
Mr. Speaker, please support No TSA Data for ICE Act that I introduced with many of my colleagues. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FREE SAMA SAFI NOW
statements.title: FREE SAMA SAFI NOW
sentences: Sama Safi is a 20-year-old U.S. citizen and honors student of psychology who was kidnapped from her home in the middle of the night by the Israeli forces.
For exactly 3 months today, Sama has been suffering in the Israeli military prisons.
They told me that Ben-Gvir, Israel's Minister of National Security, went to the women's prison where Sama is being held, and he taunted the prisoners and assaulted detainees.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
statements.title: GIVING VOICE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION PRINCIPLES
sentences: When you attack DEI, you are attacking people of color.

I grew up in the most beautiful, Blackest city in the country, where my strength and the way I move in trying to attack poverty and making sure that no child goes hungry, that we have clean air to breathe, that we have clean water to drink is because this is a city that knows what it feels like again for their government to turn their back on them.
Yet again, this administration thinks Black people are disposable.
There is no safe level of lead, but again, the Trump administration, using the anti-DEI movement, canceled programs dedicated to replacing lead pipes.
Our U.S. administration right now thinks that clean water is not a great need in our country.
Trump's attacks against DEI aren't simply a culture war.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR THE CONDEMNATION AND DENOUNCEMENT OF SOCIALISM IN ALL ITS FORMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
sentences: It is not Democratic Socialists who are fighting for universal healthcare, childcare, and clean water.

Workers rely on Medicaid, Mr. Speaker, and SNAP because of corporate greed, yet Republicans in this Chamber are literally cutting those programs to give, what, their corporate donors $4.5 trillion in tax breaks.
Yet, here we are, blaming, again, Democratic Socialists, who are trying to make life easier for our families, not the billionaire class.
I proudly say, as a DSA member: Tax the rich.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FREE YA'AKUB IRA VIJANDRE NOW
statements.title: FREE YA'AKUB IRA VIJANDRE NOW
sentences: Ya'akub is a photojournalist who has lived in the United States for 25 years as a Dreamer, as a DACA recipient.
They are trying to deport him over liking social media posts.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO DATA CENTERS
statements.title: NO DATA CENTERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Michiganders are clear: No data centers.
I am introducing a new bill, the No AI Data Centers on Federal Lands Act.
Our bill would permanently ban large data centers on Federal lands, including military bases.
It would also remove any existing qualifying AI data center and mandate site remediation to protect our health and our environment.
We know that the Department of Defense has already requested $30 billion to build hyperscale data centers.
These data centers will be built without Clean Air Act permits.
We should protect our public lands from data center destruction.
Everywhere I go in my district, all throughout Michigan, our residents are telling us data centers are not welcome.
AI data centers bring noise, light, air, and water pollution.
This past weekend, we know neighborhoods surrounding Detroit had the worst air quality in the world, and they want to make the climate change crisis even worse.
Our corrupt, AI-addicted President cannot be allowed to sacrifice our Federal lands so that Big Tech billionaires can get richer.
I will continue to push back against harmful data centers alongside our residents to protect our public lands, health, and environment.
Medical debt should also be prohibited from being on a credit report.
Adverse credit reports should not drag people down when they are already drowning in medical debt.
Restoring Fair Credit Mr. Speaker, I am introducing the FAIR Credit Act to restore the credit reports of victims of predatory lending, fraud, and financial abuse.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DTE POWER OUTAGES
statements.title: DTE POWER OUTAGES
sentences: Shame on them for throwing a $42 reimbursement for spoiled groceries and spoiled medicine, especially when grocery and drug prices have increased.
I introduced the Make DTE Pay Act just for that.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(c) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week's vote is about immediately ending all U.S. participation in the Israeli Government's violent assault against the people of Lebanon.

Over 4,200 people have been massacred since the start of the Israeli apartheid regime's brutal campaign of ethnic cleansing and territorial expansion in Lebanon, and nearly 1,000 additional people have already been killed since Congress refused to pass the Lebanon War Powers Resolution earlier this month.

Mr. Speaker, I include in the Record a June 17 report from UNICEF titled: ``Lebanon: 12 children killed, maimed daily, despite Hezbollah- Israel truce.'' Mr. Speaker, that is an innocent child being killed or maimed every 2 hours in this U.S.-assisted invasion.
The apartheid government of Israel is intentionally killing civilians, again, in Lebanon, in Palestine, and in Iran.

Mr. Speaker, I include in the Record a link to a June 18 report from the United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry titled: ``'The essence of childhood has been destroyed': Israel's deliberate targeting of Palestinian children in the Occupied Palestinian Territory since 7 October 2023.'' https://www.ohchr.org/ sites/default/files/documents/hrbodies/hrcouncil/sessions-regular/ session62/a-hrc-62-crp-2.pdf Mr. Speaker, everyone should read this horrifying report.
It finds that the Israeli military deliberately targets and kills children as part of their ongoing genocide in Gaza.
When Israeli leaders talk about applying the ``Gaza model'' in Lebanon, this is what they mean.
They say that we have already seen the Israeli military kill 251 Lebanese children during the U.S.-assisted invasion.

I include in the Record a link to a June 17 report from Amnesty International: ``Lebanon: Israel radically expands use of unlawful mass `evacuation' orders and commits war crime of unlawful transfer.'' https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/ news/2026/06/lebanon-israel-radically-expands-use-of-unlawful-mass- evacuation-orders-and-commits-war-crime-of-unlawful-transfer/ Mr. Speaker, more than 1.3 million people have already been forced to leave their homes or been killed, with the Israeli military telling them that they will not be allowed to return.
The United States is currently engaged in illegal and unauthorized hostilities, supporting the Israeli invasion of Lebanon, in violation of the War Powers Act.

The Trump administration is providing intelligence, coordinating strikes, demonstrating overt command over the Israeli military decisions, including green-lighting specific Israeli attacks and operations.
The Trump administration is also providing spare parts and maintenance to keep Israeli jets in the air.
Israeli leaders have been open about their plans.
This is about seizing Lebanon's territory, expelling its people, expanding the government of Israel's borders.

This is about ethnic cleansing and what they call, in their own words, their ``Greater Israel project.'' Just this past week, genocidal maniac Netanyahu has said that Israel does not plan to withdraw from the territory that they seized in Lebanon and that they will forcibly displace Lebanese and the people of Lebanon will not be able to return to their homes.
Mr. Speaker, I include in the Record a June 24 Haaretz article: ``Netanyahu: Israel Won't Withdraw From Lebanon `As Long as I am Prime Minister'.'' Mr. Speaker, what a great slogan for his campaign.
Israeli defense minister said that, in villages in south Lebanon: We are going to be destroying all the houses.
The Israeli national security minister, in his own words said: All of Lebanon should burn . . . all of Lebanon should become our playground.
Since the beginning, Mr. Speaker, the Israeli political and military leaders have repeatedly stated that their aim is to implement the ``Gaza model'' in Lebanon.
Prominent figures in both Israel and the Trump administration are now openly rooting for the new Lebanese civil war to further destabilize the country and prolong this invasion.
The Israeli Government does not abide by any agreements.
Time and time again, a cease-fire with Israel means: You cease; they fire.
Do not abandon your land and your people and become another subcontractor for the Israeli occupation.
The Israeli Government has killed 10 more Lebanese in the past 24 hours as we speak on this floor.
We must end U.S. support for these atrocities and force an end to the Israeli Government's invasion and illegal military occupation of Lebanese territory.
It is about bringing an end to the disastrous war with Iran.

Israel's ongoing military occupation and campaign to destroy Lebanon threatens to undermine any chance of success for a peace deal and bring our troops home, to end the war with Iran, a war which has killed countless civilians and has caused extreme economic suffering for ordinary Americans right here at home, who are already struggling to make ends meet.
They are tired of hearing that we don't have money for healthcare or childcare at home--

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING FINANCIAL STABILITY
statements.title: PROMOTING FINANCIAL STABILITY
sentences: I urge my colleagues to promote financial stability for our residents and support this bill. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIND OUR FAMILIES
statements.title: FIND OUR FAMILIES
sentences: Mr. Speaker, under the Trump administration, families are searching desperately for their loved ones who have gone missing in ICE and Border Patrol custody.

I am going to fix that by introducing the Find Our Families Act, which requires the Department of Homeland Security to maintain an accurate and more detailed online detainee locator system for all individuals detained by ICE and Border Patrol.
Mr. Speaker, no one should vanish in government custody, and I urge my colleagues to support the Find Our Families Act today. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE UNITED STATES REPRESENTS HOPEFUL NEW BEGINNINGS
statements.title: THE UNITED STATES REPRESENTS HOPEFUL NEW BEGINNINGS
sentences: He was racially profiled by local police and handed over to ICE.
They are more likely to be detained, more likely to be deported, and more likely to be denied asylum and relief.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
statements.title: HOUSING FOR THE 21ST CENTURY ACT
sentences: I am thrilled that our package includes the Housing Our Communities Act which is creating a competitive grant program to support a wide range of affordable housing planning and implementation activities for our local communities.
These grants will help increase affordable housing by supporting them in crafting housing plans, updating zoning codes, or speeding up housing inspections.
Cities like Detroit need zoning reform to create affordable housing and protect our neighborhoods from polluters, but that often doesn't happen without Federal financial support.
Mr. Speaker, I urge our colleagues to support this and make affordable housing a reality for all of our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
statements.title: DIRECTING THE PRESIDENT PURSUANT TO SECTION 5(C) OF THE WAR POWERS RESOLUTION TO REMOVE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES FROM LEBANON
sentences: Mr. Speaker, we must end the U.S. participation in the Israeli Government's violent assault on Lebanon.
Over 3,400 people in Lebanon have been massacred since the start of the Israeli apartheid government's brutal invasion and indiscriminate bombing campaign.
Children, Mr. Speaker, medics, journalists, schools, hospitals, churches, mosques have all been targeted by the Israeli Government.
More than 1.2 million people have been forced to leave their homes or be killed with the Israeli military telling them they will not be allowed to return.
Last week, Mr. Speaker, the Israeli Government issued a forced displacement order for all the areas south of the Zahrani River, declaring the entire vast region to a combat zone.
The Israeli leaders and the Cabinet members are open about this.
Finance Minister Smotrich literally called for the annexing of at least 10 percent of Lebanon saying that the new Israeli border must be up to the Litani River.
Defense Minister Katz of Israel has openly stated that the Government of Israel plans to pursue an indefinite military occupation of southern Lebanon up to the river, even after the war is over.
The National Security Minister Ben-Gvir has proposed Israel to go even further to conquer and occupy Lebanese territory all the way north of the river.
They are the Israeli security cabinet.
They are most powerful decisionmakers in the Israeli Government.
The Israeli military officials even stated that their aim is to implement ``the Gaza model'' in Lebanon.
The Trump administration has engaged in unlawful and unauthorized participation in hostilities as part of the Israeli invasion of Lebanon in violation of the War Powers Act.

The Trump administration is providing intelligence, coordinating strikes, and demonstrating overt command over Israeli military decisions, including green-lighting specific Israeli attacks and operations throughout Lebanon, including Beirut.
The President of the United States has, in his own public statements, over a period of months, asserted authority to approve, prohibit, condition, and direct specific Israeli military operations.

In one such example, the Israeli Government sought and was granted Trump's green light for its May 6 strike, the strike on Beirut, and coordinated with the U.S. in advance to coordinate with Israeli officials.
Even Israel's State officials mentioned this and said it publicly.
Even Israel's own public government state broadcasting station admitted it.

On May 7, Senator Welch and a number of Senators wrote to the administration requesting specific information about U.S. coordination with the Israeli strikes, about the Israeli strikes, and other actions that would violate the War Powers Act, including refueling, intelligence-sharing, targeting, and other assistance.
We all know the Senators have not received any answers, and the executive branch has not even tried to argue that the U.S. role in the Israeli hostilities in Lebanon complies with U.S. law.
Section 5(c) of the War Powers Act makes it clear that the Lebanon War Powers Resolution only applies to U.S. Armed Forces engaged in hostilities.
The War Powers Resolution exclusively ends the U.S. participation and ongoing Israeli invasion of Lebanon.
The Israeli bomb targeted her family's car, killing her alongside her brother, Tony, and her father, James, who is a dental surgeon in the community.
Right now, the War Powers Resolution that I have is if they are engaged in hostilities.
Mr. Speaker, section 5(c) of the War Powers Act, it is in there.
If you read the War Powers section 5(c), it is very clear.
It is in writing in the law of the War Powers Act.
Amal and her colleague Zeinab were reporting devastation in southern Lebanon when an Israeli drone struck her car near them, killing two civilians.
Amal and Zeinab sought shelter in a nearby building, but Israel then struck the building, trapping them under the rubble.
Amal is only one victim of many of the Israeli military's deliberate, indiscriminate bombings and targeting even of journalists in Lebanon.
Israel has killed 250 journalists and media workers across Lebanon, Palestine, Yemen, even Iran.
He literally threatened the major neighborhoods of Beirut will soon resemble Khan Yunis, a city in Gaza that was destroyed by the Israeli military.
They talk about greater Israel.
I think it is important, Mr. Speaker, to understand what is happening on the ground if you really care about the Lebanese people like you claim you care about the Iranian people.
I include in the Record a March 25 article from the Guardian titled: ``Israel used white phosphorus to scorch earth in south Lebanon, researcher says.'' That is the title.
Organizations such as Human Rights Watch have documented Israel's illegal use of white phosphorus multiple times in Lebanon, which is a war crime.
They launched it in residential neighborhoods and Lebanese farmland.

We are supplying these horrific chemical bombs to the Israeli military, and our military is providing operational support, as we speak, for these scorched-earth campaigns that are destroying the very conditions of life in Lebanon.
At least 128 medics--he was a medic, 17 years old--128 medics and other health workers have been targeted and killed by the Israeli Government since March, just as they have done in Gaza.

Double-tap strikes are war crimes where following an initial strike, the Israeli Government comes in, waits for the emergency rescue workers to show up with the ambulances at the scene, and then strikes again.
In Lebanon, we have seen the Israeli Government commit triple-tap, quadruple-tap strikes, an atrocity previously unheard of where team after team of rescuers are completely slaughtered.
Mr. Speaker, I include in the Record an April 16 Guardian article titled: ``Israel escalates attacks on medics in Lebanon with deadly `quadruple tap.' '' Mr. Speaker, this is Hussein Wehbe again.
He was also a paramedic and a photojournalist who was killed in a double-tap strike while trying to rescue injured survivors of an Israeli drone strike.
But the facts paint a very different picture that the Trump administration is engaged in unauthorized hostilities and violations of the Constitution and the War Powers Act of 1973.

It is important to understand that the Trump administration's actions of overt command and coordination over Israeli offensive military decisions in Lebanon arguably represent the most well-documented direct U.S. participation in a foreign military's engagement in hostilities in recent decades.

This U.S. role, Mr. Speaker, in the invasion of Lebanon includes ``green-lighting'' specific Israeli military operations in Lebanon, providing them with what is called approval and disapproval over whether they may proceed, a defining function of military command.

Mr. Speaker, on March 12, Israeli media reported that President Trump ``approved the ground incursion'' by Israel into Lebanon ``also authorized expanding it if necessary.'' Also, on April 8, Axios reporters said live on mainstream media: ``Without the green light from Donald Trump, you wouldn't have seen Israel go ahead with these very massive strikes in Lebanon,'' literally strikes that killed 250 people that day.
On May 6, Israel sought, and was granted, Trump's ``green light'' for its May 6 strike on Beirut, Mr. Speaker, and coordinated with the United States in advance, according to Israeli officials.
Not us, but the Israeli officials are telling us that the Trump administration is helping them.

As recently as this week, Israeli officials told the press that the Israeli military's forced displacement order and threats to bomb Beirut's southern neighborhoods were coordinated with the United States.
These are elected officials by the Israeli Government making these claims.

This unprecedented public record of direct and overt U.S. command and coordination over Israeli hostilities in Lebanon goes alongside deep U.S.-Israeli operational integration, which the American people don't want.
It is important to understand that the violations of the War Powers Act are very clear, as they were clear during the U.S. support of the Saudi-led war on Yemen.

Both the House and the Senate passed War Powers Resolutions bipartisanly affirming that refueling Saudi aircraft and providing targeted intelligence to Saudi forces constituted U.S. participation in hostilities.
We cannot make them out to be disposable.

Again, I think it is important to understand when we do that and label people a certain way that makes them to be disposable, it will lead to more international law violations of peoples' human rights.
He said literally that we are going to destroy Lebanese homes and villages in accordance with Beit Hanoun and Rafah models in Gaza.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to understand this is about our shared humanity.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOPPING PRICE GOUGING
statements.title: STOPPING PRICE GOUGING
sentences: No parent, not one individual, should be able to walk into a grocery store wondering if they can afford to feed their families because an algorithm or private data that the grocery chains got decided they can charge them more.
That is why I introduced the Stop Price Gouging and Grocery Stores Act to crack down on crooked pricing practices and protect consumers from corporate abuse.
Mr. Speaker, I am calling on all of my colleagues to please support me on the Stop Price Gouging and Grocery Stores Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FAMILIES DESERVE CLEAN AIR
statements.title: FAMILIES DESERVE CLEAN AIR
sentences: Mr. Speaker, DTE Energy has a monopoly in my district.
It would substantially increase monetary penalties on utilities like DTE Energy when they seek customer rate increases within two preceding or following Clean Air Act violations.
It is because DTE was hit with more than $100 million in penalties for violating the Clean Air Act by a Federal judge.
This legislation forces utilities like DTE to make a choice: Follow the Clean Air Act or face real financial consequences when they try to raise rates on customers whom they have already harmed.
Our families deserve clean air, reliable service, and accountability, not excuses and higher bills.
With the help of the far right, extreme Supreme Court, they are dismantling voting rights across the South and targeting our Black neighbors who have bled, marched, and died for our civil rights.
One million children experience homelessness every year.

Mr. Speaker, please join me in supporting the Unhoused Persons Bill of Rights resolution that lays out a real path forward, boosting affordable housing for so many of our communities, fully funding Federal housing programs, and expanding access to services for unhoused individuals.
We have seen all this before, Mr. Speaker, but like those who came before us, we will not be intimidated, we will not be silenced, and we will not back down.
We must act because our neighbors deserve a home and dignity, and we refuse to accept anything else.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE TOPS SUPERMARKET SHOOTING IN BUFFALO, NEW YORK
statements.title: FOURTH ANNIVERSARY OF THE TOPS SUPERMARKET SHOOTING IN BUFFALO, NEW YORK
sentences: We all know their lives were stolen due to racism, extremism, and the unchecked epidemic of gun violence plaguing our country.
I call on this Congress to act on gun safety legislation, including the Safe Storage Saves Lives Act.
The Safe Storage Saves Lives Act would be commonsense gun safety legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: OUR GOVERNMENT IS SPYING ON US
statements.title: OUR GOVERNMENT IS SPYING ON US
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I will always defend our rights from illegal mass surveillance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
statements.title: 2027 PRESIDENTIAL BUDGET REQUEST WILL MAKE LIFE HARDER
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I thank the gentleman from Illinois for his continued effort to protect and fight for working families.
This program would include direct financial assistance and bill payments, debt relief, reconnection assistance, and water efficiency upgrades.

We will literally take children away from homes that don't have access to water and spend money on putting them in foster care, but not make sure that, again, we have programs like this one to make sure that they are protected and have access to something that is lifesaving.

That is why Congresswoman Dingell and I are introducing the Water Access and Affordability Act to establish a permanent low-income drinking water assistance program within the Environmental Protection Agency.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VOTER SUPPRESSION
statements.title: VOTER SUPPRESSION
sentences: No matter how Republicans try to spin it, the SAVE Act is voter suppression.
They want to force Americans to produce a passport or birth certificate just to register to vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION FOR EXPOSURE OF GOVERNMENT CORRUPTION
statements.title: PROTECTION FOR EXPOSURE OF GOVERNMENT CORRUPTION
sentences: Yet, sadly, administrations of both parties are increasingly using the Espionage Act to target and prosecute whistleblowers and journalists for sharing critical information, important information, with the public.

That is why I am introducing the Daniel Ellsberg Press Freedom and Whistleblower Protection Act, which would prevent abuses against whistleblowers, journalists, and the American public for exposing government corruption.

It has been used to target whistleblowers who alerted the American people about government lies about the Vietnam war, mass surveillance, torture, drone assassinations, and the U.S. war crimes in Iraq and Afghanistan.

In recent years, the use of this repressive tool has prosecuted whistleblowers and journalists acting in the public interest and has expanded dramatically, producing a major chilling effect on the right to dissent in our country.
This legislation is named in honor of the late Daniel Ellsberg, the celebrated whistleblower who bravely exposed government lies about the Vietnam war with the publication of the Pentagon Papers.
Today, our government is committing horrific war crimes against humanity, from Iran to Palestine to Cuba, while expanding mass surveillance and spying on Americans more than ever.
Many mosques are full of memorials, and many, many, again, are watching their grandparents' homes be bombed and seeing relatives, uprooted from their neighbors, becoming homeless.
This campaign of ethnic cleansing by the Israeli Government has already killed nearly 1,000 people, including over 100 children that we know of.

Over 1 million people in Lebanon, one-fifth of Lebanon's entire population, has been forcibly displaced and told by the Israeli military that they will not be allowed to return to their homes and their villages.
Trump has already cut $1 trillion from programs like Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act, so I introduced a bill to be able to hone in on the pharmaceutical industry.
It is called Medicines for the People Act, a plan to develop essential medicines and medications in the public sector and distribute them to all Americans at not-for- profit rates.

We all know that there are real consequences to these higher costs and fewer breakthroughs in the industry that prioritizes profits over public health, so I urge my colleagues to please support Medicines for the People Act.
Mr. Speaker, it is time to build a system that ensures that lifesaving prescription drugs are affordable and accessible to everyone.
If we allow Presidential administrations to continue to abuse this power and erode our rights, we will lose our freedom of speech and so much more.
Mr. Speaker, I will be introducing a House Resolution standing with the people of Lebanon against these war crimes and calling for an end to this illegal invasion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOUSING IS A HUMAN RIGHT
statements.title: HOUSING IS A HUMAN RIGHT
sentences: The Housing Our Communities Act directs the HUD Secretary to establish a competitive grant program to support a wide range of affordable housing planning and implementation activities.

For example, grants can support officials in crafting their housing plans, updating their zoning codes, or increasing capacity to conduct housing inspections so that new developments are completed faster and much more efficiently.
This bill provides civil servants and policymakers with the support they need to make affordable housing a reality for so many of our communities.
I urge my colleagues in the Senate to pass this legislation immediately and begin to address the housing crisis that is devastating our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
statements.title: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
sentences: People were jogging around our parks and getting stopped to be asked what their legal status was.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP BODY CAMERA PAYWALLS
statements.title: STOP BODY CAMERA PAYWALLS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, we all know the public deserves full transparency when it comes to holding police accountable for misconduct.
Instead, States and cities all across our country have started adopting new laws to charge the public hundreds of dollars in fees to view or access police body camera footage.
These videos are public records and are essential for accountability and justice for victims of police violence.

Putting this footage that should be publicly available behind a paywall makes achieving accountability much more difficult for our residents, especially those who won't be able to afford it, and they tend to be the ones more frequently abused by police.

That is why I am introducing the Stop Body Camera Paywalls Act to prevent any State or unit of local government that creates a paywall for access to these public records from receiving Federal law enforcement grants.
Again, we must make sure that we have transparency, especially when it comes to Federal law enforcement grants.
This bill is a necessary step in a wider effort to end police impunity for abuses and ensure the utmost transparency, accountability, and justice for our communities. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT
statements.title: PROMOTING EFFICIENT REVIEW FOR MODERN INFRASTRUCTURE TODAY ACT
sentences: Mr. Chairman, we know that the dirty water bill reduces significant oversight for the Clean Water Act, and it is really important to know that polluters are pushing to weaken this--not residents, not families, and not communities that are directly impacted.
Children not only have the right to be able to not go hungry, but they have a right to breathe clean air.
It is because we know that clean water and clean air is never a priority.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
statements.title: PROTECT AMERICA'S WORKFORCE ACT
sentences: We know the executive order was the largest act of union busting in our Nation's history.
It stripped away collective bargaining rights of over a million Federal employees in over 40 Federal agencies.
Many people in this Chamber know that a union may have helped them achieve the dream that they have of serving, as well as being able to take care of their families.
Many of us are recipients indirectly or directly because of unions.
Collective bargaining isn't a privilege, Mr. Speaker, that can just be signed away.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support Protect America's Workforce Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING MICHIGAN COMMUNITIES FROM DATA CENTERS
statements.title: PROTECTING MICHIGAN COMMUNITIES FROM DATA CENTERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 267 percent, that is how much energy prices increase in communities located near Big Tech data centers.
Do you like clean water coming out of your taps at affordable prices?
So do I. You better hope a data center doesn't get built near you.
Do you like breathing clean air and being outdoors?
Organize like hell to keep these extremely loud data centers and their emissions out of your community.
The Silicon Valley billionaires don't care about our communities.
They don't care that these data centers will absolutely make life miserable.
I am so inspired by the grassroots movement in the State of Michigan right now popping up all over the State to protect our communities from data centers.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ECONOMIC DIGNITY FOR ALL
statements.title: ECONOMIC DIGNITY FOR ALL
sentences: There is an affordability crisis in our country, and the corporations and billionaires driving up these costs don't care.
I hear it from them: Formula, diapers, and childcare are all out of control.
Families face new expenses of childcare, diapers, baby clothes, and more, while many parents must take time off leading up to and following the birth of a newborn.
Without universal childcare, parents are often forced to choose between healing, caring for their newborn, and keeping their job.
Roughly 134,000 families are driven into poverty annually because of the cost of childcare alone.
What is not effective is continuing to give billionaires big tax breaks.
An unexpected expense like medical bills should not be a threat to a family's financial livelihood.
I am not going to wait for President Trump to keep his promise to address the cost of living in this country.
I am going to help and push back and introduce the economic dignity for all agenda, a plan to tackle the high cost of living in our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EPSTEIN REMARKS
statements.title: EPSTEIN REMARKS
sentences: The Treasury Department, Mr. Speaker, is sitting on suspicious activity reports on Epstein's financial network, detailing thousands of transactions totaling more than $1.5 billion.
The corrupt administration would rather protect the rich and powerful, their billionaire donors, and stop the truth from coming out.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GENOCIDE IN GAZA
statements.title: GENOCIDE IN GAZA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as we speak right now, the Israeli Government is moving to exterminate Palestinians.
The International Association of Genocide Scholars, hundreds of the world's leading experts on genocide, has determined that the Israeli Government is committing genocide.
Mr. Speaker, this week, the United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry has concluded that the Government of Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

It calls on all countries to take immediate concrete actions to prevent and punish genocide, to stop sending weapons to the Israeli Government, and to bring individuals forward, again, to hold them accountable and to seek justice for the genocide.
As we speak, the Israeli military is moving to wipe what remains of Gaza city off the map.
Mr. Speaker, this is not only the Israeli Government's genocide.

It was also another son of Detroit, my predecessor and founder of the Congressional Black Caucus, Congressman John Conyers, who stood with Dr. King and later became the driving force behind making Dr. King's birthday a national holiday.
Mr. Speaker, as some of my colleagues continue to try to attempt to bully and silence me, I will remind all of them that I grew up in Detroit.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TAXING EXCESSIVE CEO PAY
statements.title: TAXING EXCESSIVE CEO PAY
sentences: The average Starbucks worker made less than $15,000 a year.
They would have to work more than 6,000 years to match Starbucks' CEO pay.
This is why I am introducing the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act.
While these CEOs float around on their yachts, millions of Americans, our residents, are drowning in credit card debt and struggling to keep their heads above water.
They are on Medicaid and getting food assistance because their CEOs are focused on profit and their own pay instead of taking care of their workers.
This bill would apply higher corporate tax rates to companies that pay their CEOs higher amounts of compensation compared to their workers.
That is the trigger, 50-1, that a company will pay more in corporate tax if that is the case.
This will not only incentivize more reasonable CEO pay packages, but it would also compel companies to increase their workers' pay and take care of their workforce.
I urge my colleagues to please support the Tax Excessive CEO Pay Act.
That is not where they get, literally, healthcare, mental health support, and the things they need.
It seems my colleagues can always find time and money for war, but when it comes to clean water, when it comes to being able to address the needs of our people, there is never enough money.

I want people to look at this and pay attention because they will never, ever fully fund Medicaid, universal school meals for every hungry child, or guarantee healthcare as a human right in our country.

I introduced an amendment to this war machine budget to add the Stop Politicians Profiting from War Act to put an end to this corruption by banning Members of Congress and their families from owning defense stocks.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING RECOVERY FOR FLOOD VICTIMS
statements.title: PROVIDING RECOVERY FOR FLOOD VICTIMS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, as flooding becomes more frequent due to the climate crisis, it is crucial that we take action to require FEMA to provide flood victims with the full resources that they need to rebuild their lives.
Ending Corporate Greed Through Price Gouging Mr. Speaker, families in our communities are facing an affordability crisis.

These custom, personal profiles on many of our families and residents allow companies to charge different people different prices for the same exact item by using things like mobile apps, online shopping, and facial recognition technology.
It will harm working families who are already struggling to make ends meet.
I introduced the Stop Price Gouging in Grocery Stores Act to ban personalized price gouging by grocery stores, and I urge my colleagues to join me in this effort. ____________________
I urge my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to support this legislation.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISASTROUS FLOODS
statements.title: DISASTROUS FLOODS
sentences: That is why I am proud to introduce the Fix Our Flooded Basements Act to make sure that Federal disaster assistance finally covers those costs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BUDGET BETRAYAL
statements.title: BUDGET BETRAYAL
sentences: It will cut Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act by over $1.1 trillion.
The impact will also be felt in rural areas where hospitals and community health centers will close because they rely heavily on Medicaid reimbursements.
We all know we have sick care in our country, and Medicaid is the only Band-aid right now to keep it all together.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STARVATION IN GAZA
statements.title: STARVATION IN GAZA
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the Israeli Government has deliberately blocked food, medicine, and fuel from entering Gaza.

Maybe if my colleagues would close their eyes, or pretend that they are not Palestinians, they would care, that they would care that Palestinians have been forced to eat grass and animal feed--they are human beings--while thousands of trucks carrying food sit blocked at the border.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SURVEILLANCE PRICING IN GROCERY STORES
statements.title: SURVEILLANCE PRICING IN GROCERY STORES
sentences: It is shameful that companies like Kroger are price-gouging our residents with surveillance pricing.

We know that facial recognition technology discriminates against our Black and Brown neighbors.
They are telling me every day that gun violence is just increasing.
Every day, over 125 Americans are killed from gun violence and more than 200 people are shot and wounded.
This Gun Violence Awareness Month, let's do something to save lives.
This legislation mandates every firearm seller to include a gun lock or gun safety device every single time a gun is sold in the United States.
Far too often, irresponsible gun owners fail to properly secure their weapons with tragic consequences, leading to accidental deaths, preventable suicides, school shootings, and other mass violence.
I am introducing the Safe Storage Saves Lives Act with Representatives DeLauro, Frost, and Kelly to reduce firearm deaths among our children.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CARIBBEAN AMERICAN HERITAGE MONTH
statements.title: CARIBBEAN AMERICAN HERITAGE MONTH
sentences: Through their engaging events, Mr. Speaker, they have celebrated the rich cultural heritage of the Caribbean and its significant impact on our communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO MORE WARS
statements.title: NO MORE WARS
sentences: President Trump violated the United States Constitution by sending the United States troops to bomb Iran without congressional authorization.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VIOLATIONS OF RIGHTS BY ICE
statements.title: VIOLATIONS OF RIGHTS BY ICE
sentences: People are now seeing it for themselves and understanding why we say abolish ICE, which was created in 2003.
I agree that we must abolish ICE and protect our communities and neighbors.
Local police profiled him--yes, they did--Oh, he can't speak English, let's call immigration.
I stand with those defending our immigrant neighbors and our fundamental rights.
We stand with residents in Detroit and throughout the country who refuse to let Black history be erased.
We are committed to uplifting their stories and carrying on the movement for true equity and dignity for all.
That is why I support the abolition amendment, which would strike this shameful exception from our Constitution and end the legalized practice of slavery in the United States.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JOB CORPS CUTS
statements.title: JOB CORPS CUTS
sentences: We are going to fight together to restore the funding.

As the chair of Congressional Mamas Caucus, I will continue to lead efforts in Congress to defend these critical programs for generations to come.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BUDGET CUTS WILL HARM FAMILIES
statements.title: BUDGET CUTS WILL HARM FAMILIES
sentences: I can't believe that many of my Republican colleagues, many of whom have larger numbers of folks on Medicaid, are proposing the largest cut to food assistance in the history of our country and the largest cut to Medicaid in the history of our country.

If it wasn't bad enough, this all is being done to give trillions of dollars--not billions or millions, but trillions of dollars in tax breaks to the billionaire class and the largest corporations--corporations that do not need these tax breaks.
Don't worry, Mr. Speaker, there is a budget that got increased, which is the Pentagon and the defense budget.
The war machine of the Pentagon budget can't pass an audit; seven audits in a row.
It only seems to be an outcry when we are trying to, again, feed children who are hungry or to help make sure that people, again, through no fault of their own getting sick, get covered by Medicaid.
The budget would cut crucial programs for the poor and working families.
Mr. Speaker, when you talk about waste and when you talk about fraud, you look at the Pentagon budget.
Again, many of my colleagues have a lot more people on Medicaid than my district does.
We can do that by ensuring that Medicaid covers all prenatal and postnatal care.
I know over 40 percent of births in our country are covered by Medicaid, Mr. Speaker.
Instead of voting to make life easier, they are supporting polluters, corporations, and billionaires who do not need it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDICAID
statements.title: MEDICAID
sentences: This is about billionaires first and corporations first.

She said: ``I am terrified about what the Trump administration is doing to those of us living in poverty with these cuts to SNAP and Medicaid. ``My family and I could not survive without these programs.

It is bad enough we are struggling to purchase the basic essentials and have been heavily leaning on food pantries not only for extra food but also for toilet paper and soap.'' That is with having the benefits that they have now. ``I am waiting for my Social Security case to go on appeal.
With less people working at the Social Security office, it has taken longer than it should to review my case. ``I am barely surviving as it is, and I couldn't see any of my doctors without Medicaid.

My single daughter and myself both rely on SNAP to eat and Medicaid to see our doctors. ``It is very clear those voting for these cuts have never experienced the traumatic effects of living in poverty and the threat of taking the only help we have away.
I will take a moment to bring part of my district into this Chamber.
I will read a letter from Angeline from Redford Township.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE NAKBA NEVER ENDED
statements.title: THE NAKBA NEVER ENDED
sentences: We, of course, see that the Israeli Government continues to illegally steal Palestinian land in the occupied West Bank where my family lives.

The dehumanization and the anti-Palestinian racism here is painful, especially when my colleagues remain silent on the starvation of children and vote to send more bombs to the Israeli Government while they commit war crimes with impunity.
The Israeli Government is using starvation as a weapon of war, which is a war crime.
The thousands of trucks carrying food and lifesaving aid sit blocked at the border while Palestinian families starve.
Israeli forces have killed more than 52,000 Palestinians, and nearly 70 percent of them were women and children, babies who did not live to see their first birthday.
The Israeli Government will not stop until we put in place an arms embargo.
Mr. Speaker, my ``grandma's''; ``sity's'' only crime in the eyes of the Israeli apartheid government was that she was born Palestinian.
Sneaking In Nonprofit Killer Bill Mr. Speaker, I want to talk about something that is happening right here in our backyard in regard to the Congressional Mamas Caucus.

We started Mamas for Medicaid, which is mothers across the Nation sharing their stories about what it means to cut Medicaid and how cruel it will be for their families, especially those with children with special needs.
It will be those who are fighting against the Medicaid cuts.
It will be those who are fighting for Black lives and those who are fighting for climate justice.

Mr. Speaker, Peter Beinart said: ``When you tell a people to forget its past, you are not proposing peace, you are proposing extinction.'' I introduced a resolution yesterday recognizing the 77 years of the ongoing Nakba against the Palestinian people and the need for refugee rights.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DTE RATE INCREASE
statements.title: DTE RATE INCREASE
sentences: President Trump's first 100 days in office have eroded constitutional rights, illegally and lawlessly dismantled Federal agencies, and consolidated power into the hands of the billionaire class.
He has empowered an unelected billionaire like Elon Musk to fire Federal workers without cause and dismantle the programs our families depend on.

President Trump has attempted to override the Constitution through executive order to end birthright citizenship, deport American citizens without due process, including a 4-year-old with cancer, and he has openly defied Supreme Court orders.
Instead of gutting healthcare and Medicaid and food assistance in our public school system, Congress should make the ultrarich pay more taxes and make these programs work better for the people.
Mr. Speaker, 60 percent of working families are living paycheck to paycheck.
Working families are worried about paying their rent, covering the costs of groceries, and what they are going to do if they get sick.

He plans on giving $7 trillion, not millions or billions, in tax cuts to billionaires while making working families pay for them by cutting $880 billion from Medicaid and $230 billion from food assistance.
Our children deserve clean water, and they deserve to breathe clean air.

I always remind my residents, Mr. Speaker, that we didn't get the Civil Rights Act or transformative change in our country or the right to organize unions because of what folks do here in this Chamber.
That is how we got the Civil Rights Act and the right to organize labor unions in our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JUSTICE FOR VICTIMS OF AGENT ORANGE
statements.title: JUSTICE FOR VICTIMS OF AGENT ORANGE
sentences: That is why I am proud to introduce the Victims of Agent Orange Act and the Agent Orange Relief Act, because we know that the devastating harms that our country committed in Vietnam did not end in 1975.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DISAPPROVING THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATING TO "OVERDRAFT LENDING: VERY LARGE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS"
statements.title: DISAPPROVING THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF CONSUMER FINANCIAL PROTECTION RELATING TO "OVERDRAFT LENDING: VERY LARGE FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS"
sentences: Working families, as many of us know, are struggling with rising costs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING SOCIAL SERVICES AND PROGRAMS
statements.title: DEFENDING SOCIAL SERVICES AND PROGRAMS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Republicans are advancing, as we all know, a budget that includes $880 billion in cuts to Medicaid to pay for tax breaks for billionaires.
Just so we are clear, the $880 billion cut to Medicaid is the largest Medicaid cut in American history.
There are 72 million people who rely on Medicaid for healthcare in our Nation, including 40 percent of people in Speaker Johnson's own district.
Mr. Speaker, for families, seniors, and people with disabilities who rely on Medicaid, it is the difference between life and death.
Yet, right now, the future of Medicaid is under threat.
I have heard many of my Republican colleagues in this Chamber try to gaslight the American people and claim that the budget does not make cuts to Medicaid.
Senator Hawley, as we know, just offered an amendment to the same legislation right now that came through this Chamber to strip the $880 billion in Medicaid cuts out of that bill.
The amendment literally said: To strike the section related to reconciliation instructions to the Committee on Energy and Commerce of the House of Representatives to cut $880 billion from Medicaid.
Those who rely on Medicaid aren't just a number.
They depend on Medicaid for health services, treatment, and medication that they simply cannot afford due to our broken healthcare system.
As the chair of the Congressional Mamas' Caucus, I need to bring this to light because this is important when we talk about Medicaid.

Medicaid plays a critical role in supporting maternal health, covering a significant portion of births in our country and providing access to healthcare for pregnant women and postpartum individuals, including prenatal care and postpartum services.
Cutting Medicaid, again, is going to be a life-or-death situation for our families, including birthing women.
Here we are watching, again, folks choose billionaires over the people who elected them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VOTER SUPPRESSION, PLAIN AND SIMPLE
statements.title: VOTER SUPPRESSION, PLAIN AND SIMPLE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the SAVE Act is not about protecting elections; it is about silencing voters.
The so-called SAVE Act is also attacking, of course, voting rights and our access to the ballot box.
Very clearly, Federal law already prohibits noncitizens from voting in Federal and State elections.
Over 21 million Americans lack easy access to the documents this law would require for voter registration.
The SAVE Act would target marginalized communities like those in my district, and of course impacting people of color, naturalized citizens, and low-income folks.
Mr. Speaker, 69 million American women would also be unable to register to vote simply because they changed their last name after they got married.
We need to pass legislation to stop billionaires from buying our elections, not making it harder for the American people to vote.
I am going to vote ``no'' on this bill.
I did it last term, and I am going to do it again.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
statements.title: DEFENDING EDUCATION TRANSPARENCY AND ENDING ROGUE REGIMES ENGAGING IN NEFARIOUS TRANSACTIONS ACT
sentences: We know that President Trump is the biggest threat to our education system in America right now, not someone in North Korea or China.

That is why I am introducing amendments to this bill to ensure that transparency around our universities and the relationships with so-called countries of concern include countries whose leaders have active arrest warrants issued against them by the International Criminal Court, to include countries actively on trial with the International Court of Justice for violating the Genocide Convention and the Geneva Conventions.
They are only interested in voting to protect governments like the Israeli Government's apartheid regime.

In fact, many of my colleagues have cheered on expulsion, arrest, and deportation of university students calling for the exact type of transparency and exercising their First Amendment right, Mr. Chair, their constitutional right.
Mr. Chair, I think ``countries of concern'' is perfectly explained in my amendment.

Some of them are literally openly killing American citizens, and the countries of concern, to explain--this is so important--that the International Court of Justice, if there is any violation, these are violations to the Geneva Convention and the Genocide Convention.
When it comes to governments like the government of Israel, my colleagues are willing to throw international law in the shredder.

Any country--Iran, China, Russia--any country that has an active investigation or has arrest warrants for their leadership in the International Criminal Court system and these international systems that are in place was to prevent and, again, protect the interests of the American people.
What we are doing here is attacking and targeting universities because we don't like that their student body read about the atrocities that the Government of Israel is doing.
Mr. Chair, in closing, I think it is important to know right now the International Court of Justice is investigating Congo, Uganda, Philippines, Venezuela, and Sudan.
I fully support financial transparency in our universities.

I am calling for transparency, Mr. Chair, around university investments in companies profiting from violations of international law, but my colleagues are not interested, of course, when it comes to that sort of transparency.

I think it is important that if we are going to be consistent about whether or not we are protecting American interests, what about Americans that are being killed by countries of interest that I am trying to include here?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MICHIGAN HAS 2.6 MILLION PEOPLE ON MEDICAID
statements.title: MICHIGAN HAS 2.6 MILLION PEOPLE ON MEDICAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I remind many of my constituents in the 12th Congressional District that I hear you and I understand the pain and the fear that you all are going through as you continue to hear about the $880 billion in Medicaid cuts.
In Michigan, 2.6 million residents have Medicaid.
We have got to stick with the people, not the billionaires. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDICAID
statements.title: MEDICAID
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Republicans are ramming through $4.5 trillion in tax cuts for billionaires and corporations.

So when I hear people say that is not what is happening when it is very evident, when Republicans are cutting $880 billion, specifically in a committee that works on Medicaid, where do people think it is going to come from?
For this Chamber to be able to pay for the cuts for the billionaires and powerful corporations, they are literally ripping healthcare away from millions of our families.
Nearly 80 million people across the country rely on Medicaid and the children's health insurance program for access to healthcare.
Medicaid is a program that provides prenatal care for expectant mothers, vaccinations for our children, and treatments for chronic conditions.
For those who rely on Medicaid, it is not just a service, Mr. Speaker.
Right now, the future of Medicaid is under threat.

They depend on Medicaid for treatment and medication that is life or death, for health services they simply cannot afford elsewhere because we have sick care in our country, and we haven't had the courage to take on the industry.
Medicaid, Mr. Speaker, is the primary source for long-term care in our country.
Long-term care in our country depends on Medicaid funding.
Without Medicaid, our seniors could be forced to live without healthcare protections at the moment they need them the most.
We will not allow them to fund tax cuts for billionaires, who can afford healthcare, by stripping away healthcare for our most vulnerable.

This administration is sending a message that they couldn't care less about not only our veterans, but the fact that we have a right to breathe clean air and we have a right to be protected by those who abuse their power.
Mr. Speaker, these unaccountable billionaires are coming after all of our Federal workers, and it is an important reminder that it is not just a worker, but that these are individuals.
We will see what the impact will be on our families.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AGENT RAUL GONZALEZ OFFICER SAFETY ACT
statements.title: AGENT RAUL GONZALEZ OFFICER SAFETY ACT
sentences: It is because we are going to allow the targeting of communities that look like my district, to police them and to militarize them.

If my colleagues really wanted to address it, let's get to the core issues of the fact of who is benefiting the most from not allowing our families and our loved ones who have been here for decades and years to be able to have a pathway to citizenship.
We are voting on yet another bill that just promotes racial profiling.
Mr. Speaker, I will be very clear, though.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: UNHOUSED TRAGEDY
statements.title: UNHOUSED TRAGEDY

It is estimated that ending homelessness in our country could cost as little as $11 billion.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
statements.title: PROTECTING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION
sentences: Don't allow the little minion billionaire to do it.
President Trump's minion, Elon Musk, wants to steal hard-earned money from the working class to reward their billionaire donors and CEOs, to protect them, not us.

I know that the CFPB has had a huge impact on the lives of my residents, doing things like capping credit card late fees, holding companies who break the law accountable, targeting junk fees, and eliminating $49 billion in medical debt from people's credit reports.
They helped also protect 15 million Americans that have medical debt on their credit report.
It was supposed to be implemented in March to remove medical debt from people's credit report.
I know that doesn't matter to these billionaires, but it makes a world of difference for our families who are just trying to make ends meet.
I have no idea why they are handing their duties and responsibilities and the oath of this office over to a billionaire that never took the oath. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTING AMERICAN ENERGY PRODUCTION ACT
statements.title: PROTECTING AMERICAN ENERGY PRODUCTION ACT
sentences: Fracking is practically unregulated at the Federal level because 20 years ago then-Vice President Dick Cheney, the former CEO of Halliburton, inserted a loophole into the Energy Act of 2005, explicitly exempting fracking chemicals from EPA regulation under the Safe Drinking Water Act.
Halliburton, of course, is one of the largest oil and gas companies in the world and also just happens to be behind most of the major fracking worldwide.

For the last 20 years, we have been stuck with the so-called Halliburton loophole, a terrible reminder of the revolving door of oil money in politics and how Big Oil buys its way into the Halls of Congress and the White House every single day.
In fact, our new Secretary of Energy is the founder and former CEO of Liberty Energy, another fracking company.
Moreover, the Halliburton loophole isn't the only giveaway that fracking benefits from.

Under the Clean Water Act, there are provisions to prevent polluted stormwater runoff from contaminating our waters unless--there is an exemption--the runoff comes from oil and gas development facilities.
Madam Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote against this environmental destruction and protect our drinking water that is in crisis right now throughout our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BLACK HISTORY MONTH
statements.title: BLACK HISTORY MONTH
sentences: I know the current administration is now attempting to dismantle foundational civil rights protections, diversity, equity, and inclusion, and roll back our hard-won progress here in our country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LOWERING COSTS FOR AMERICANS
statements.title: LOWERING COSTS FOR AMERICANS
sentences: I want everyone to think about this because the Federal minimum wage is $7.25 right now.

Instead, we are seeing threats of tariffs that will drive grocery prices higher.
I know that this doesn't matter to the current President and his billionaire friends.
They don't worry about the cost of a carton of eggs or milk or groceries, especially when the three wealthiest men in America are sitting right behind the current President at his inauguration.
It is clear that the billionaires now control our government, and this Chamber can't let that happen.
I know you are distracting us because you are helping your billionaire friends, but you are hurting so many American people who are drowning right now with the cost of living.
We are punishing sanctuary cities that embrace our immigrant neighbors.
He is already doing it for the Muslim ban, many of our neighbors, myself, my family, all of us.
He is even trying to override the 14th Amendment of the Constitution to end birthright citizenship.
It is clear from my residents and folks around the country there is absolutely no doubt if you are born in the United States, you are a U.S. citizen.
They want us distracted so they can help their billionaire friends become richer.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LAKEN RILEY ACT
statements.title: LAKEN RILEY ACT

That is what you want to turn our neighborhoods into, is militarization?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CALIFORNIA DISASTER AID

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THANKING MICHIGAN'S 12TH DISTRICT
statements.title: THANKING MICHIGAN'S 12TH DISTRICT
sentences: As we begin the 119th Congress, I am determined more than ever to continue to fight for clean air, clean water, ending utility shutoffs, holding corporate polluters accountable, lowering the cost of living for working families, protecting Social Security and Medicare, and growing the Congressional Mamas Caucus, as well as, of course, ensuring equality and justice for all.
I will always have their backs, and I will never sell out. ____________________
